pairs.difference: A: the telescope tube is cream, the ground is lavender-gray moon dust and the wall is flat teal. In the lens, the tripod legs and the whole floor merge into one gray-mauve mass, and the copper legs are the only warm note. The subject and the ground are equally dull (0.070 / 0.070, background below the real range), and warm share is 0.14, below the real minimum. B: the green binoculars sit on warm honey planks. The green body keeps its hue in shadow, there are blue lenses as the accent, and the card holds a clear warm/cool split like the real cards.
pairs.fix: Paint the moon ground a clear cool blue-violet, not dusty gray. Make the backdrop a saturated striped color. Give the tripod and tube trim a strong warm brass-orange, so the card has one bright warm hero color against the cool ground.

pairs.difference: A: the dome base is white and the moon ground is gray-lavender, under a purple sky. In the lens, almost everything is one violet family (1.62 hue families, warm share 0.005). The small yellow hatch is the only other hue. B: the pool bar has a cyan pool, a brown thatch roof, a green stool and fruit accents. It has several hue families with related warm shadows, inside the real range.
pairs.fix: Add warm local colors to the moon base: an orange or yellow hull stripe, a warm-lit doorway and amber window glow. Tint the moon ground a cleaner blue instead of gray-lilac, so the card is not all one purple-gray.

pairs.difference: A: the rover body is near-neutral white-gray and the wheels are black on gray dust. The subject chroma is 0.025, far below the real 0.071 minimum. Against the acid-green rays, the hero reads as colorless, and only the small orange dish is warm. B: the taxi is a saturated yellow with cool blue glass, and the asphalt shadow keeps a warm brown in the lens. It has a clear hero hue against a blue background.
pairs.fix: Give the rover a strong local color on its body, such as a bright orange or yellow chassis with blue solar panels. Make the wheels dark blue-gray rather than pure black, so the hero is as colorful as the background.

pairs.difference: A: the control console is neutral gray-white on a gray riveted floor. The subject chroma is 0.025, and the only color is small red and yellow buttons. In the lens, the buttons collapse into one orange, and the background is a flat orange wall (warm share 0.906, above the real range). B: the popcorn cart has a red body, a red-white awning and gold trim against a blue wall. Its shadows stay a rich deep red, and it has a balanced warm/cool palette.
pairs.fix: Paint the console body a definite color, such as teal or blue panels with a cream top. Make the floor cool, slightly blue tiles, so the warm orange wall and the red/yellow buttons read as accents rather than the whole card.

pairs.difference: A: the red scarf is a saturated red with darker red shadows, and a gold badge is the accent on blue swirls. Its chroma is high but its hue roles are clear. B: the asteroid is a gray-brown rock, and in the lens it splits into tan and a dead dark brown. Shadow chroma is 0.217, far below the real 0.741, so the shadow side goes muddy. The subject chroma is 0.06, below the real range. The orange flames are the only color.
pairs.fix: Paint the asteroid as a colored rock, such as a warm purple-brown with blue-violet shadows instead of muddy dark brown. Make the craters a richer related color, so the shadow side keeps its hue.

pairs.difference: A: the flip-flops have coral soles and yellow straps on a teal striped wall. They have warm/cool contrast and related darker coral shadows. B: the Saturn has an orange-yellow ball and ring on a violet striped wall. The background chroma is 0.257, above the real 0.217 maximum, so the background is as loud as the hero. In the lens, the planet and ring flatten into one yellow plus one pink, with only 1.85 hue families.
pairs.fix: Calm the purple background to a softer lilac. Give the planet more distinct bands, such as cream, orange and a cool blue-teal stripe, so the hero has more than one warm family and the background rests the eye.

pairs.difference: A: the flowerbed is full of rainbow blooms in a tan stone ring on a magenta and pink backdrop. It has many hue families but sits within the real range. B: the camping chair has a green canvas on gray tubes against a red-orange wall and a peach floor. In the lens, the green goes olive. Both cards sit inside the real ranges on every field, and neither shows a clear palette tell.

A: the astronaut helmet is a white shell with a gray-lilac base on a pink wall. The subject chroma is 0.075, and the background chroma is 0.122, below the real 0.138 minimum. The lens shows mostly pale lavender-white masses, with the amber visor as the only strong color. B: the sneakers are a saturated blue with lime and teal accents on a warm orange and cream set. The hero and the background are clearly separated.
pairs.fix: Give the helmet a colored shell, such as orange or blue panels and trim. Make the backdrop a saturated pink-magenta, and tint the table a cool blue instead of pale gray-lilac.

pairs.difference: A: the satellite dish and its concrete post are neutral gray. The subject chroma is 0.024, far below the real 0.051 minimum. The hero is colorless against the warm sand and blue sky, and only the tiny red tip is chromatic. B: the sandcastle is a warm sand orange with a green bucket and blue shovel as accents. Its shadows keep a related orange-brown.
pairs.fix: Paint the dish a real color, such as a white dish with a red or orange frame and a blue-painted post. Make the post's shadow side a cool blue-gray instead of flat neutral gray.

pairs.difference: A: the UFO is a gray metal saucer with a green dome and orange lights on a yellow ring backdrop. In the lens, the whole saucer is one olive-gray mass. The subject chroma is 0.057, below the real 0.082 minimum, and warm share is 0.943, above the real 0.727 maximum. B: the music player is a saturated orange device with white earbuds on violet rings. The hero is orange against a cool background, with a neutral white rest area.
pairs.fix: Paint the saucer body a colored metal, such as teal or purple, with a cool blue shadow side instead of gray. Calm the yellow background slightly, so the card is not almost entirely warm.

pairs.difference: A: the submarine is a yellow body with copper portholes on a dark, deep green-teal backdrop. The background chroma is 0.095, below the real 0.117 minimum. The card is darker and muddier than the real cards' bright backgrounds. B: the rocket has a silver body, red nose and fins, and cyan portholes on bright cyan rays. Its chroma is in range, the hue roles are clear, and the metal picks up a cool reflection.
pairs.fix: Brighten the backdrop to a clear, saturated aqua or teal sunburst instead of a dark bottle-green, so the background is as clean and colorful as the yellow hull.

pairs.difference: A: the golf iron and ball are cool silver-white on green grass under a blue sky. Warm share is 0.002, and in the lens the club, ball and sky merge into pale mint-gray, with no warm note anywhere. B: the beach umbrella is red, yellow and orange on cyan rings. The subject chroma is high (0.174), but it has a clear warm-hero/cool-background split like the real cards.
pairs.fix: Add a warm element to the golf card, such as a red or orange grip and tee and a warm sunlit yellow-green on the grass. Keep the club's metal slightly warm in the light, so the card is not entirely cool.

pattern: Generated cards draw the hero in near-neutral gray or white with almost no local color: subject chroma about 0.02–0.07 on the rover, console, dish, UFO, helmet and moon base. Their moon ground is a dusty gray-lilac, and the warm/cool balance is broken, either almost no warm (moon base, telescope) or almost all warm (UFO, console). Real cards always give the hero one strong local color against a contrasting saturated background, and their shadows keep a related color instead of going muddy brown or gray (asteroid).
